title: Deputy Manager/Manager - Ocean Freight & EXIM OPS
description:
Deputy Manager / Manager – Ocean Freight \& EXIM Operations
   

  

**Company:** 
 Caterpillar Signs Pvt. Ltd. – Group Bayport
   

  

**Function:** 
 Supply Chain \& Logistics – International Trade Operations
   

  

**Location:** 
 Gandhinagar SEZ, Gujarat
   

  

**Experience:** 
 8–17 Years
   

  

**Band:** 
 Deputy Manager / Manager, based on experience and candidate calibre
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Head – Logistics / Sr. Manager – Logistics
   

  

**Direct Reports:** 
 Nil initially; team\-building opportunity as business volumes grow
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Deputy Manager / Manager – Ocean Freight \& EXIM Operations** 
 to take end\-to\-end ownership of the organization's non\-express international trade operations.
   

  

 The role will oversee
 **ocean and air exports, imports, third\-country/cross\-trade shipments, marketplace and retail partner inbound movements, and trade compliance** 
 across India, overseas entities, and international trade lanes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be a
 **hands\-on EXIM professional** 
 with strong experience in export, import, cross\-trade operations, documentation, customs coordination, freight forwarding, and compliance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Export, Import \& Cross\-Trade Operations
* Manage end\-to\-end execution of non\-express international shipments from booking through delivery and invoice settlement.
* Handle sea and air export operations from the SEZ, including booking, documentation, customs filing through CHA, container stuffing, and export realization requirements.
* Manage imports of raw materials, consumables, spares, and capital goods into SEZ and DTA locations.
* Handle international inbound movements for overseas entities, including destination customs entry coordination.
* Manage third\-country / cross\-trade shipments, including switch Bills of Lading, neutral packing, third\-party invoicing, origin documentation, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate marketplace and retail partner inbound shipments, ensuring compliance with routing guides, ASN accuracy, appointment schedules, labeling, and load requirements.
* Documentation \& Trade Compliance
* Prepare, verify, and maintain complete shipment documentation, including:
+ Commercial Invoice
+ Packing List
+ Shipping Bill / Bill of Entry
+ Bill of Lading / Air Waybill
+ Certificate of Origin
+ Insurance and inspection certificates
+ Customer\-specific documentation

* Coordinate with CHAs on HS classification, valuation, licensing requirements, and customs filings.
* Review shipping bills and customs entries before submission.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FEMA, DGFT, SEZ, customs, and merchanting\-trade requirements.
* Maintain accurate, audit\-ready documentation and records.
* Ensure appropriate application of Incoterms 2020 and destination\-country regulatory requirements.
* Freight \& Logistics Management
* Select appropriate freight mode, service, and routing based on cost, transit time, and customer commitments.
* Manage freight forwarders, CHAs, shipping lines, and overseas agents against defined service levels.
* Maintain freight rate benchmarks by lane and mode.
* Monitor shipment status through a live shipment tracker and proactively manage delays, rolled containers, transshipments, and delivery issues.
* Monitor and control free time, demurrage, and detention costs.
* Negotiate free days and proactively escalate potential cost exposures.
* Review freight and logistics invoices line\-by\-line before submission to Finance.
* Stakeholder \& Vendor Management
* Act as the single point of contact for all internal stakeholders for non\-express international shipments.
* Coordinate with Production, Quality, Finance, Customer Experience, overseas entities, and other relevant functions.
* Manage external logistics partners, freight forwarders, CHAs, and overseas agents.
* Provide timely shipment updates and clear written communication to internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure marketplace and retail partner requirements are consistently met and proactively address chargebacks.
* Reporting \& Cost Management
* Maintain accurate shipment and logistics trackers.
* Prepare periodic MIS reports covering:
+ Cost per shipment by lane and mode
+ Demurrage and detention
+ Chargebacks
+ Claims filed and recovered
+ Shipment status and exceptions

* Identify cost\-saving opportunities across freight, routing, and logistics operations.
* Present data\-backed and costed recommendations for decisions involving logistics or trade costs.


 Candidate Profile
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on professional who has personally executed EXIM operations rather than only supervised a team.
   

  

**Candidates May Come From Either Of The Following Backgrounds**
**Freight Forwarding / NVOCC / CHA**
* Experience with international freight forwarders, NVOCCs, consolidators, or licensed CHAs.
* Strong understanding of documentation, agent networks, destination\-side coordination, and freight economics.


**Corporate EXIM**
* Experience managing end\-to\-end export, import, and cross\-trade operations within an established organization.
* Experience handling multiple business units, brands, international customers, and overseas entities.


**Essential Requirements**
* 8–12 years of relevant experience for Deputy Manager level; Manager\-level candidates may be considered based on experience and calibre.
* Hands\-on experience managing both export and import operations.
* Strong exposure to third\-country / cross\-trade shipments or a closely comparable international trade structure.
* Strong knowledge of EXIM documentation and customs procedures.
* Experience coordinating with CHA, freight forwarders, shipping lines, and overseas agents.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple stakeholders and international shipments simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and ownership of compliance and documentation.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in SEZ, EOU, or bonded warehouse operations.
* Overseas import filing exposure.
* Marketplace or retail partner routing\-guide experience.
* Experience in a high\-SKU / customized product environment.
* Exposure to international e\-commerce supply chains.


 Technical Knowledge
   

  

**Candidates Should Have Working Knowledge Of**
* Bill of Lading types, including Switch B/L and Telex Release
* Air Waybill
* Certificate of Origin – preferential and non\-preferential
* Shipping Bill and Bill of Entry procedures
* SEZ and DTA customs processes
* HS classification and valuation
* Duty structures and customs query/examination/release processes
* FEMA export/import realization requirements
* DGFT regulations and schemes
* Merchanting\-trade requirements
* SEZ statutory returns and record keeping
* Incoterms 2020
* Ocean and air freight rate structures and surcharges
* Free time, demurrage, and detention
* Letters of Credit at a working level
* FCL / LCL operations
* Container types and stuffing planning
* VGM, transshipment, and rolled\-container recovery
* CFS and port processes
* Marketplace routing guides and ASN systems
* Advanced Excel


 Education
   

  

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Post\-graduation in International Business, Foreign Trade, Supply Chain, or a related field is preferred.
* Trade or customs certification will be an added advantage.


 Growth Opportunity
   

  

 The Selected Candidate Will Have The Opportunity To Progress To Manager – EXIM Based On Demonstrated Performance And Successful Achievement Of Defined Business Objectives, Including
   

  

* Establishing documented processes that operate independently.
* Reducing documentation errors, customs queries, demurrage, detention, and chargebacks.
* Establishing and managing cost\-per\-shipment benchmarks by lane and mode.
* Maintaining an audit\-ready compliance framework.
* Developing and supervising junior team capability as business volumes increase.

 UNDP has been working in India since 1951 in almost all areas of human development. Together with the Government of India and development partners, we have worked towards eradicating poverty, reducing inequalities, strengthening local governance, enhancing community resilience, protecting the environment, supporting policy initiatives and institutional reforms, and accelerating sustainable development for all.

As the integrator for collective action on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) within the UN system, we are committed to supporting the Government of India’s national development vision and priorities and accelerating the achievement of the SDGs for the people and the planet.

* Strong, accountable and evidence\-led institutions for accelerated achievement of the SDGs.
* Enhanced economic opportunities and social protection to reduce inequality, with a focus on the marginalized.

title: Cutting & Sorting Manager - Cutting Department
description:
**Job Description: Cutting Department Manager**
**Department**
 Cutting \& Sorting
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 To manage the complete throughput of the Cutting Department — including cutting machines, manual cutting, and the sorting team — by ensuring high people productivity, optimal machine efficiency, minimal fabric and foam wastage, timely order execution based on ageing, accurate cut\-kit dispatch to vendors, and error\-free cutting and sorting to eliminate kit returns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Throughput \& Productivity Management
* 
+ Own end\-to\-end throughput of all cutting machines and the sorting team.
+ Monitor and drive machine efficiency (OEE) and operator productivity on a daily/shift basis.
+ Track output vs. plan for cutting and sorting; identify and resolve bottlenecks in real time.
+ Set and review productivity benchmarks (pieces/hour, kits/day, machine utilization %) for operators and machines.

* Cutting Operations (Fabric, Foam \& Manual)
* 
+ Plan and supervise fabric cutting, foam cutting, and manual cutting operations.
+ Deploy manual cutting judiciously for small\-scale/low\-volume requirements to optimize material usage and reduce wastage.
+ Continuously identify opportunities to reduce fabric and foam wastage through better marker planning, lay optimization, and cutting sequence.
+ Ensure correct cutting specifications, patterns, and sizes are followed as per order requirements.

* Order Prioritization \& Scheduling
* 
+ Track ageing of all pending orders and use ageing data to prioritize the daily/weekly cutting schedule.
+ Prepare and maintain a cutting schedule/plan aligned with dispatch commitments and order priority.
+ Coordinate with planning, merchandising, and production teams to align cutting schedules with overall production flow.

* Sorting \& Kit Management
* 
+ Supervise the sorting team to ensure accurate sorting and kitting of cut components.
+ Ensure cut kits are complete, correctly matched, and free of defects before dispatch.
+ Ensure cutting and sorting processes are executed error\-free to eliminate kit returns from vendors/downstream units.

* Vendor Kit Distribution
* 
+ Ensure cut kits are distributed to vendors strictly as per the agreed dispatch plan and timelines.
+ Maintain proper documentation and records of kits dispatched — including quantity, date, vendor, and order reference.
+ Coordinate with logistics/dispatch teams to ensure timely and accurate handover of kits.
+ Track and resolve any discrepancies or delays in kit distribution.

* Quality \& Wastage Control
* 
+ Implement checks/controls to minimize cutting errors, mismatches, and material wastage.
+ Conduct root\-cause analysis on kit returns or cutting errors and implement corrective/preventive actions.
+ Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce rework, wastage %, and kit rejection rate.

* Team Management
* 
+ Lead, train, and manage cutting machine operators, manual cutters, and the sorting team.
+ Plan manpower deployment/shift allocation based on order load and machine availability.
+ Monitor attendance, discipline, and performance of the team; conduct performance reviews.
+ Identify training needs and build a skilled, multi\-tasking workforce.

* Records \& Reporting
* 
+ Maintain accurate records of cutting output, wastage, machine efficiency, kit dispatch, and returns.
+ Prepare and share daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports with management on department performance.
+ Ensure documentation is audit\-ready and compliant with internal SOPs.

* Machine \& Resource Management
* 
+ Ensure preventive maintenance of cutting machines is planned and executed to avoid downtime.
+ Coordinate with maintenance team for timely breakdown resolution.
+ Monitor machine efficiency and take corrective action for underperforming equipment.


**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**
* 
+ Cutting \& sorting throughput vs. plan
+ Machine efficiency / OEE %
+ Fabric \& foam wastage %
+ On\-time cut\-kit dispatch to vendors (%)
+ Kit return rate (target: zero/near\-zero)
+ Order ageing compliance in scheduling
+ Team productivity and attendance
+ Accuracy of dispatch and production records


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 
+ Graduate in Textile/Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or related field (relevant experience may be considered in lieu).
+ 5–10 years of experience in cutting department operations within furniture, mattress, upholstery, garment, or foam\-based manufacturing.
+ Proven experience managing cutting machines (fabric/foam) and sorting/kitting teams.
+ Hands\-on exposure to manual cutting operations is preferred.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* 
+ Strong understanding of fabric and foam cutting processes and wastage optimization techniques.
+ Good planning and scheduling skills, especially order\-ageing\-based prioritization.
+ People management and team leadership skills.
+ Data\-driven approach — comfortable maintaining records/MIS in Excel or ERP systems.
+ Strong coordination skills with planning, merchandising, dispatch, and vendor teams.
+ Problem\-solving mindset with focus on quality and error elimination.
+ Attention to detail and process discipline.
